ruleDefinitions.name: Script Interpreter Execution From Suspicious Folder
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a suspicious script execution in temporary folders or folders accessible by environment variables

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-ep\\ bypass\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-ExecutionPolicy\\ bypass\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-w\\ hidden\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/e\\:javascript\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/e\\:Jscript\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/e\\:vbscript\\ .*")) OR (process_original_file_name = "cscript\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "mshta\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "wscript\.exe")) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Perflogs\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\Temp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Temporary\\ Internet.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Temp.*")) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Favorites\\\\.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Favourites\\\\.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Contacts\\\\.*"))))
